policy: Real, separately locatable primary or independent institutional evidence leads. Not pre-verified findings. Reviewer must read and corroborate before KEEP.

items.title: Survey of Federal Funds for Research and Development 2024–2025 (Volume 74)
items.source: U.S. National Center for Science and Engineering Statistics (NCSES)
items.context: Original federal funding survey: independently examine FY2024 realised obligations versus preliminary FY2025 estimates and agency distribution; funding obligations are not expenditures.

items.title: The State of U.S. Science and Engineering 2026 — Global Research and Development
items.context: International R&D comparative indicators from documented data; do not confuse purchasing-power estimates with nominal exchange-rate spending or identify spending with scientific outcomes.

items.title: Statistical Communiqué on National Expenditures on Science and Technology in 2025
items.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China
items.context: Chinese 2025 R&D expenditure release, including basic-research share and intensity. Government-reported statistics are primary evidence of reported figures; compare with OECD methodology and independent series.

items.title: OECD Main Science and Technology Indicators — R&D expenditure growth and international comparison, March 2026
items.source: OECD Main Science and Technology Indicators
items.context: OECD cross-country R&D comparisons for 2024 distinguish PPP from market-exchange-rate valuations and describe methodological uncertainty.

items.title: Science. Technology. Innovation: 2026 — HSE Statistical Data Book
items.source: HSE University Institute for Statistical Studies and Economics of Knowledge
items.context: Original data book compiles Russian science and technology input/output indicators, mostly sourced from official statistical institutions; independently check table periods and definitions.

items.title: Russia — Nature Index research output and international research collaborations
items.context: Curated-journal research-output and collaborator metrics; do not generalise the limited journal panel to all Russian research. Check window, fractional counts and collaboration shares.

items.title: Frontlines and faultlines: how the Russo-Ukrainian conflict reshapes the landscape of scientific research
items.source: Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (Nature Portfolio)
items.context: 2026 large-scale bibliometric study of Russian and Ukrainian scholarly activity and migration using publications up to 2023. Recheck methodology, direction of bilateral scientific collaboration changes, and period limits; not a real-time 2026 publication-output measure.

items.title: OECD Main Science and Technology Indicators — international R&D funding and personnel
items.context: Independent international framework to contextualize US R&D spending and researcher trends. Compare definitions and data year rather than echoing a US announcement.

items.title: OECD Main Science and Technology Indicators — international R&D comparison 2026
items.context: Use carefully to contextualize Chinese R&D intensity; OECD indicator data can originate in national statistical returns and may NOT be independently measured.

items.title: WIPO Global Innovation Index 2026 — US innovation inputs and output indicators
items.context: Indicator-based global innovation positioning, not a single technological breakthrough or proof of national superiority.

items.title: WIPO Global Innovation Index 2026 — China innovation and global clusters
items.context: International index of 2026 innovation and technology clusters, carefully distinguish patent quantities, innovative outcomes, and investment.

items.title: WIPO Global Innovation Index 2026 — cross-country innovation benchmarking
items.context: Cross-country benchmarking, check country coverage and availability of Russia; missing data cannot support a finding.

items.title: UNESCO Institute for Statistics 2026 global R&D data release
items.context: International official-statistical comparisons; check if Russian figures for the specific year exist before claiming any trend.

items.title: UNESCO Institute for Statistics 2026 global R&D data release
items.context: International R&D intensity and full-time-equivalent researcher indicators; check source series and observation year.

items.title: 2025 national economic and social development science technology China
items.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China
items.context: PRELIMINARY government statement; numbers revised in October 2026 release. Not independent confirmation of that release.

items.theme: Innovation systems, infrastructure and knowledge transfer
items.title: WIPO Global Innovation Index 2026 country profile and innovation indicators — South Korea
items.context: Independent LLM review is required to identify any substantive 2026 change in South Korea innovation indicators, methodology and comparison with the existing EU-centred Radar. The index is international statistical evidence, not standalone proof of a causal improvement.
